I hope you did not drop MUSR. Sir literally curves at the end and gives bonus marks here and there throughout the course. I don’t know what the other person who commented is on about, saying to avoid MUSR. Sir mid ar final e ekdom haat khule marks dey; even an average written paper gets good marking, I would say. Just try to do well on your quizzes, he takes 4 quizzes and counts 2. Give your 200% there, as these are solid numbers. He takes two assignments, no viva. I got full marks on both of my assignments. Also, don’t bunk classes after punching your ID card... he dislikes it, and trust me, he will notice and remember your name, face, and serial number. Also, if he sees you giving effort or trying, he will remember that as well, and it will work in your favour. I did PSY101 last semester and received an A (of course, with effort). It’s a psychology course, so you have to study, and if you study, you will receive a good grade under him.
